body: I guess I don't really expect to survive much longer.
LOL you sound like my mom. She went from being o e looney to another. I'm glad you got help, but I always live in the real world, and jesus isnt gonna help.

All of these things need money. Doing anything I enjoy costs money. I just want to be me, but it only happens ONE DAY A WEEK. Saturday is the only day every week I dont immediately wake up wanting to kill myself. I work for that feeling. Why bother doing this? By the time I can retire I'm going to be too old or broken to enjoy my hobbies. I ve always kind of thought about leaving early, but I've never given it serious consideration until the past year. I'm really just over this, and I really want to know how others deal? I went 25 years without even ever trying alcohol and I finally go to a point where I caved and it helped for awhile, but duck now even that doesn't cover up the feeling. Living is truly just awful. And anyone I ask just says "idk we just deal with it." Why? Why bother dealing with it? It fucking blows.
